title: Build Grave Accord with 66 bosses, Crazed forms and class upgrades
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Grave Accord implements 66 identities (65 ordinary plus one secret), seven classes, 378 skills, 28 weapons, six maps and five modes. This remains unfinished feature-branch development. PR #14 stays draft and protected main remains separate.

Ratcatcher's late phase now marks a short patrol before locking new scent lanes from its actual stop. Both boss and sack resolve against masonry. Pack spawns honor their warned origins; the sack uses relative swept contact and retains earned next-pack cancellation. Rats use bounded paths around cover after their initial scent leg. Brutal/Crazed add one or two fully warned gapped whistle rings using shared 2.5x/7.5x projectile budgets. Original Standard combat numbers, the twelve-rat cap and all existing artwork/music remain. Fifteen-locale help, authoritative casting clocks and real owner/observer replication are covered.

Constable, Warden, Courier and Ratcatcher have individual quality implementations: 4 of 60, with 56 remaining and human acceptance open. Early Watch and Small Wakes remain six integrated original encounters. All 66 identities admit Crazed. Insane forces Brutal; Hellish forces Crazed. Compact arenas, the structured boss header, distinct priority phase bell and reduced-motion-aware transition animation remain. Combat revival stays Baby 100%, Easy 50%, Normal 25%, Hard+ disabled. Phase circles remain Baby/Easy Standard only; cover/lava policies remain.

The 21 purchased ability transformations, optional all-54 skill map, profiles/mastery/cosmetics/remaps, all five modes and bank-safe consented secret are implemented. Known protocol 22 local Practice/profile migration preserves exact form/build history; older bounded migrations remain and online/signed state stays strict.

Validation: 526 automated tests, authored content/fifteen locales, TypeScript and production build pass. Sixteen new regressions cover patrol/pack/sack/navigation/whistle/cleanup/migration/presentation and real two-client replication. A separate actual-Game audit observes 216 combinations for 216,000 ticks with multiple musters; it is not full endurance or capacity acceptance. All previous asset blobs and the other 65 complete boss definitions are preserved. Current verification and retained failed attempts are under reviews/ratcatcher-muster-2026-10-26/. Earlier Courier and Crazed evidence remains separately preserved. Inspect actual HEAD and its own CI. Software evidence does not establish rendered, device, native-language, listening or final balance acceptance.

The target still needs 85 new ordinary identities and 56 individual quality passes. Special/action art, human balance/listening/device/language review, active mixed-progression/WAN/endurance/capacity, hosted recovery/rankings and coordinated release remain open. Normal recovery writing stays disabled. Canonical Wiki publication remains 18 pages and 34 unchanged images, verified against exact committed blobs and public image hashes. All frozen previews remain preserved. The public protocol 4 Site and immutable protocol 13 Windows archive stay separate. No deployment, main merge, paid provisioning or contest submission is included.
